market_data.raw_policy: cache outside Git; version compact SHA-256 provenance

causal_split.rule: fit every regime estimator and preprocessing transform only on calibration rows; infer each later decision from observations no later than that decision

jump.feature_recipe: exact nine-feature v0 recipe in the research-author Nasdaq example: EWM return, log EWM downside deviation and EWM Sortino at half-lives 5, 20 and 60
jump.preprocessing: jumpmodels DataClipperStd(mul=3) then StandardScalerPD, both fit on calibration only
jump.state_order: fit(sort_by='cumret'); package state 1 is lower-cumulative-return bear state
jump.inference: predict_online on one expanding post-calibration prefix; never predict/smooth over future rows

volatility.state_order: component with larger calibration mean DD-log_20 is high volatility
volatility.inference: predict_proba independently at each observed day

hmm.input: same nine calibration-standardized author-example features as JumpModel
hmm.state_order: state with lower calibration weighted mean market return is bear
hmm.inference: last posterior from each expanding prefix; the last forward-backward posterior has no later observation

adwin.inference: single chronological update stream; snapshot only after processing a date

portfolio.decision_rule: compatibility evaluation only unless a shared-budget, point-in-time, corporate-action-consistent return panel exists without changing the frozen single-stock estimand

ranker.label: within decision_date/profile percentile future_xirr * 4, clipped to 3 and converted to integer
ranker.maturity: training endpoint must be strictly before evaluation decision date

evaluation.cohort: exact frozen common cohort: same rows with every frozen BASE_CANDIDATE, every challenger ranker score and observed future outcomes within each date/profile query; compute every 67/33 rank blend only after this filter
evaluation.selection_rule: prefer lower mean goal shortfall; require no material loss of coverage; report all metrics and date/profile stability
evaluation.uncertainty_unit: decision date, with profiles averaged within date

boundaries: Never write production or frozen shadow artifacts
No market observation after a row's decision date
No future outcome enters its own model fit
No silent imputation of market observations
Preserve source panel blockers and execution semantics
Do not promote any result to production
